summary: The tally app is built at `desk:apps:tally` and tested: it starts from the saved count, handles +, -, r and Enter as specified, and only Ctrl+Q closes it. I also removed the `desk:tally` page my test created, so the desk is back to its starting state apart from the app page.

files.desk:apps:tally:
app 'Tally'
task start()
set n to 0
when exists('desk:tally')
set n to number(trim(read('desk:tally')))
done
give {n: n}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is '+'
set s.n to s.n + 1
or when k is '-' and s.n > 0
set s.n to s.n - 1
or when k is 'r'
set s.n to 0
or when k is 'enter'
write('desk:tally', text(s.n))
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'Count: ' & s.n)
title('Tally')
help('+ add  - take away  r reset  Enter save  Ctrl+Q close')
done
